thread:
maria (AE): Borealis wants to run a gated 2-week POC. They returned our enterprise auth checklist with extra asks: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, RBAC mappings, enforced domain allowlist, audit retention, and POC pricing. Need a short list of asks to unblock.
lee (SE): I'll draft the checklist. Essentials to request: IdP metadata (XML or Okta/Azure app URL), ACS URL/EntityID to use, NameID preference (email vs persistent), SAML attribute names for email/displayName/groups, SCIM base URL + bearer token, expected provisioning cadence and estimated user count, bulk import plan if >5k users, canonical group list for mapping.
sam (Security): Add data residency, SOC2 evidence, KMS options (customer-managed?), log access rules, audit log retention window (90/180/365?), and subprocessors. Also ask if they need IP allowlist or VPC peering.
jess (Legal): For procurement, we need: procurement contact, PO requirements, and whether NDA needed before we share SOC2. For POC we can offer credit applied to first invoice or a small fixed fee. I'll prepare a short SOW + DPA.
maria (AE): Timeline: start Mon 2/1, 2 weeks, decision meeting 2/22. They asked for a POC price and a Starter Dedicated estimate at 120k tok/day. What's reasonable?
lee (SE): For a small hosted POC (dev seats, ~5k tok/day) recommend $700/week for reserved dev pool to guarantee latency. Dedicated at ~120k tok/day approx $8k-$10k/mo depending on model; note quantization and model choice affect cost.
lee (SE): Quick SCIM sample we can send:
POST /scim/v2/Users
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
{"userName":"m.chan@borealis.com","name":{"givenName":"Mina","familyName":"Chan"},"emails":[{"value":"m.chan@borealis.com","primary":true}],"externalId":"borealis-42","groups":[{"display":"eng"}]}
lee (SE): SAML: request their IdP metadata. We'll provide SP metadata with ACS/EntityID and support group assertions and attribute mappings. Test plan: IdP login -> SCIM create -> group sync -> role assignment.
sam (Security): RBAC: get canonical group->role mapping sheet. Confirm admin roles and emergency access. We offer time-limited emergency admin tokens and full audit logging of admin actions. Default SCIM rate limit is 100 req/min; can be raised for Dedicated. For bulk imports (>10k) suggest CSV import.
maria (AE): Domain proofing: they want tenant creation gated by verified domains. What are our options?
lee (SE): Two methods: DNS TXT record per domain (recommended) or admin verification email. For orgs with many domains we can pre-approve a domain allowlist in tenant settings. Include instructions + DNS TTL expectations.
jess (Legal): If they ask for SOC2 before signing, we'll request an NDA and then share redacted report. For export controls or on-prem requests, flag to infra team.
ops-bot: Created channel #sales-borealis-poc (ws: w-4556) and invited SE/security/legal.
maria (AE): Actions: lee(send checklist + examples today), sam(start questionnaire answers), jess(draft SOW + DPA). I'll collect procurement contact and confirm POC price. Target: checklist out today, SOW by tomorrow.
lee (SE): I'll include a sample group->role mapping table and a short SSO troubleshooting checklist (IdP clock skew, audience mismatch, missing attributes).
sam (Security): Drafting answers now. Expect questions on key rotation cadence, who can access logs, and tenancy isolation. If they require on-prem/private deployment escalate to infra.
maria (AE): Also include rollback plan if SSO fails: emergency admin tokens and invite links for dev POC only. Please note in onboarding doc.
jess (Legal): Please share procurement contact and whether they need a redline of MSA. I'll prepare a POC clause that converts into a committed credit if they purchase.
maria (AE): Thanks all. I'll ping Borealis after checklist and price micro-approval. :thumbsup:
